answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent docks once at a shared jetty of attested tasks, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake. A walnut-hard shell of checkable history then guards the ledger: a hollow claim with no countersignatures earns nothing. No haven of unearned reputation can shelter copies, because a record of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once.
